q: Need a long-only MACD 12, 26, 9 crossover system on the 15-minute candles. Size in at half size of equity when flat on a bullish cross. While in the trade, pyramid up to two more times, adding another half size whenever the close pushes at least 2 ATR of the entry over the last add price, capping total size at full port. Manage it inside a box anchored at the entry price, with a hard stop 1 ATR behind and a TP 2 ATR ahead. Every time a close clears another 2 ATR in the green beyond the anchor, ratchet the whole box forward by 2 ATR steps, and let opposite MACD flips bail you out.

attempts.text: Need a long-only MACD 12, 26, 9 crossover system on the 15-minute candles. Size in at half size of equity when flat on a bullish cross. While in the trade, pyramid up to two more times, adding another half size whenever the close pushes at least 2 ATR of the entry over the last add price, capping total size at full port. Manage it inside a box anchored at the entry price, with a hard stop 1 ATR behind and a TP 2 ATR ahead. Every time a close clears another 2 ATR in the green beyond the anchor, ratchet the whole box forward by 2 ATR steps, and let opposite MACD flips bail you out.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: MACD(12,26,9) line crossing its signal line. Bullish when the MACD line crosses above the signal line (at or below on the previous bar, strictly above now); bearish on the cross below.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Position size: start with 0.5 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 2 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.5 (total capped at 1.0), at most 2 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Moving box: the trade lives in a box anchored at the entry price, with the stop 1 x entry ATR behind the anchor and the target 2 x entry ATR beyond it. Every time a bar closes at least another 2 x entry ATR in profit beyond the current anchor, shift the whole box (anchor, stop and target) 2 x entry ATR in the trade's favour (repeat if the close cleared several steps). The box never shifts back.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Run a Donchian breakout on the 15, trading both ways when flat. Size in using risk 1% of equity per 2 ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. Entry is a 48-bar breakout. Stop and TP start 2 ATR from entry. Whenever price closes another 1 ATR in the green past the anchor, ratchet the box up 1 ATR. An opposite signal closes the open trade. After any exit, sit on hands for 16 bars before re-entering.

attempts.text: Run a Donchian breakout on the 15, trading both ways when flat. Size in using risk 1% of equity per 2 ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. Entry is a 48-bar breakout. Stop and TP start 2 ATR from entry. Whenever price closes another 1 ATR in the green past the anchor, ratchet the box up 1 ATR. An opposite signal closes the open trade. After any exit, sit on hands for 16 bars before re-entering.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 48 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 48 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Position size: volatility-scaled. Fraction of equity = 0.01 x close / (2 x ATR(14)) on the signal bar, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05.
- Moving box: the trade lives in a box anchored at the entry price, with the stop 2 x entry ATR behind the anchor and the target 2 x entry ATR beyond it. Every time a bar closes at least another 1 x entry ATR in profit beyond the current anchor, shift the whole box (anchor, stop and target) 1 x entry ATR in the trade's favour (repeat if the close cleared several steps). The box never shifts back.
- Cooldown: after any trade ends, take no new entry for 16 bars, counted from the bar on which you first see yourself flat (entries allowed again from that bar + 16).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Build a long-only breakout and retest strategy on the 15 using a 48-bar Donchian level. When price closes above that high, arm for 16 bars to buy the retest when a candle's low hits the level, with newer breakouts replacing old ones. Only take longs if the 1h close is above its 20 EMA. Risk 1% of equity per 1 ATR, capped at 100% and floored at 5%. Put TP at 3 ATR. Once a candle closes at least 2 ATR in the green, move stop to breakeven, and at 3 ATR, scale out half size and let the rest ride. An opposite signal gets us flat.

attempts.text: Build a long-only breakout and retest strategy on the 15 using a 48-bar Donchian level. When price closes above that high, arm for 16 bars to buy the retest when a candle's low hits the level, with newer breakouts replacing old ones. Only take longs if the 1h close is above its 20 EMA. Risk 1% of equity per 1 ATR, capped at 100% and floored at 5%. Put TP at 3 ATR. Once a candle closes at least 2 ATR in the green, move stop to breakeven, and at 3 ATR, scale out half size and let the rest ride. An opposite signal gets us flat.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: breakout then retest. When the close is strictly above the highest high of the 48 bars before the current bar, remember that high as the breakout level (a newer breakout replaces the old one and restarts the clock). The setup stays armed for 16 bars after the breakout bar. While armed, the first bar whose low trades at or below the level is the bullish signal and disarms the setup; if more than 16 bars pass first, the setup simply expires. The bearish version is the mirror image (close below the 48-bar lowest low, then a high at or above that level). Arming, expiry and triggering are checked on every bar, in or out of a position; a newer breakout in either direction replaces the armed setup.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: volatility-scaled. Fraction of equity = 0.01 x close / (1 x ATR(14)) on the signal bar, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05.
- Breakeven: once a bar closes at least 2 x entry ATR in profit, move the stop to the entry price for the rest of the trade (it never moves back).
- Scale out: the first time a bar closes at least 3 x entry ATR in profit, cut the position to half its current size (once per trade); the rest stays on.
- Take-profit order 3 x entry ATR beyond the entry price.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.
